item.title: View, edit, and replay your recorded Zest scripts
item.description: The ZAP Browser Extension (version 0.3.0) has a new Script Viewer. You can now see the Zest script you are recording as you record it, then edit it, replay it step by step, and load and save it, all without leaving the browser.
